full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 36
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Friday, Ashadh 26, 2083
1:00 PM
Letter from the Office of the President
To read out the letter received from the Office of the President regarding bill certification.
Presentation of Annual Reports
On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Pushpa Kamal Dahal 'Prachanda', the Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Ms. Sobita Gautam, will present:
(a) The '20th Annual Report of the Election Commission, 2081/082'.
(b) The '8th Annual Report of the National Security Council, 2081/082'.
(c) The '18th Annual Report of the National Women Commission, 2081/082'.
Management Work
On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Pushpa Kamal Dahal 'Prachanda', the Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Ms. Sobita Gautam, will present the proposal 'Consideration of the National Service Corps Bill, 2083'.
Discussion and Ratification of Treaties
The Honourable Minister for Youth, Employment and Labour, Mr. Ramjee Yadav, will present:
(a) The proposal 'Discuss the Protocol No. 29 to the Forced Labour Convention, 1930 (No. 29) of the International Labour Organization, 2014 in the House'.
(b) The proposal 'Ratify the Protocol No. 29 to the Forced Labour Convention, 1930 (No. 29) of the International Labour Organization, 2014'.
(c) The proposal 'General Discussion on the Labour Inspection Convention, 1947 (No. 81) of the International Labour Organization'.
(d) The proposal 'Ratify the Labour Inspection Convention, 1947 (No. 81) of the International Labour Organization'.
Pashupati Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
